Qu'est-ce que Heartopia?

Heartopia is a relaxing slow-life simulation jeu from XD. The officiel site presents it as a calm social and creative life-sim experience with mode, in-jeu footage, and multi-language support. Fan sites communly track PC, iOS, Android, and Steam routes, plus codes, hobbies, animal de compagnies, maison planning, and wiki databases.

FAQ

Is this an officiel Heartopia website?

No. Heartopia Hub is an independent fan resource. It is not affiliated with XD, the developer, publisher, or officiel Heartopia channels.

Are all codes guaranteed actif today?

No. codes are pulled from public fan suivis and can expire without notice. The useful part is the priority, expiry note, recompense category, and source date so joueurs know what to test first.

Why include base de donnees rows if the full jeu donnees is still changing?

Because a good guide site should be transparent about sample size. This launch version gives verified-style tables and clear update paths, then can expand into hundreds of item, poisson, recette, PNJ, and animal de compagnie rows later.

title: A propos de Heartopia Hub
description: About Heartopia Hub, an independent fan resource with editorial standards for Heartopia codes, guides, outils, and base de donnees pages.
content:
Editorial transparency

About Heartopia Hub

Heartopia Hub is an independent fan resource built to help joueurs find practical, verified, and clearly explained Heartopia information.

What We Publish

We publish beginner guides, code verification notes, carte planning frameworks, lightweight outils, and base de donnees standards. The goal is to explain player decisions, not simply repeat names, numbers, or rumor posts from other sites.

Editorial Method

  • code claims are separated into verified, expires, and unverified states.
  • guides explain tradeoffs, assumptions, and update timing.
  • Base de donnees pages should include source confidence and practical player advice before publication.
  • Thin placeholder pages should stay unpublished or noindexed until they have useful content.

Independence

This website is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or operated by Heartopia, the jeu's developer, or its publisher. Names and jeu references are used for identification and fan commentary.

Confidentialite Policy

This policy explains what Heartopia Hub collects, how advertising may work, and how visitors can control cookies and personalized ads.

Information We Collect

This static website does not require an account and does not ask for passwords, jeu account donnees, payment details, or personal profile information. If you contact the site owner by email, your message and email address may be used to respond to your requete.

Cookies And Analytics

The en cours version does not include analytics scripts. If analytics are added later, this policy should be updated to name the provider, explain the donnees collected, and describe opt-out choices.

Google AdSense And Advertising

When Google AdSense or other advertising partners are enabled, third-party vendors may use cookies or similar technologies to serve ads based on a visitor's prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on visits to this site and other sites on the internet.

Visitors can review ad personalization choices through Google's advertising settings and can learn more about third-party advertising choices through recognized industry opt-out resources. If this site serves users in regions with additional consent requirements, a compliant consent mechanism should be added before personalized advertising is enabled.

External Links

This site may link to officiel jeu pages, publisher channels, and community resources. External websites have their own privacy practices and are not controlled by Heartopia Hub.

Contact
